meta.name: Samantar Hindi 720p WEB DL
meta.description: What if two individuals share the same destiny- the same palm lines, then what would happen? Samantar is a story about a young man Kumar Mahajan, whose life changes after he goes on journey to find, Sudarshan Chakrapani, a man who shares the same destiny with him. The life that Kumar is living is the life that Chakrapani has already lived. Will Kumar be able to control his present or change his future after meeting Chakrapani?

videos.title: Identical stranger
videos.overview: Kumar Mahajan, a typical middle class man, over-burdened with work and is prone to bad incidents in life. Kumar's friend, Sharad, forcefully takes him to an astrologer, Swami, who shockingly reveals that he has seen his hand before.

videos.title: Mishap
videos.overview: Swami denies telling him his future. He speaks about Sudarshan Chakrapani, who was also denied being told of his future. After a series of unfortunate events, Kumar decides to look for Sudarshan Chakrapani who also has lived the same life.

videos.title: Switch
videos.overview: Kumar unfolds that he is leading the life same as Sudarshan Chakrapani as he gets transferred to Kolhapur, where the blue moon cottage catches his eye. On the other hand, Sharad is trying to find whatever he can about Sudarshan Chakrapani.

videos.title: Blue Moon Cottage
videos.overview: Kumar requests his boss to allot the Blue Moon Cottage to him. Upon shifting, Kumar notices similarities between himself and Sudarshan. He later comes across Bablya, who asks for a bribe in exchange for information about Sudarshan.

videos.title: The Finding
videos.overview: Bablya tells him that Chakrapani worked at the Imperial Woods Company. Upon researching, Sharad calls Kumar saying Sudarshan was transferred to its Karjat branch. Later destiny hints to Kumar that he should immediately leave for Karjat.

videos.title: Sudarshan Chakrapani
videos.overview: Kumar reaches Imperial Woods Company and asks the manager about Sudarshan Chakrapani. As he collects more information on Chakrapani, he lands himself in Retibunder- Chiplun, where he finally meets Sudarshan.

videos.title: Past Life Crisis
videos.overview: Kumar intends to have a conversation but Sudarshan stops him and asks him to rest for the night. He offers him some whisky after which Kumar passes out. Next day, they sit down to talk and realize that they indeed share the same destiny.

videos.title: The Diaries
videos.overview: Kumar and Sudarshan talk about their past, realizing that all the dots connect. Kumar asks Sudarshan to tell him about his future. Sudarshan agrees to handover a set of diaries to warn him about his future, only with certain conditions.

videos.title: Twist
videos.overview: Kumar has been promoted due to Kanjaria's death. He keeps on reading one page of the diary every day before sleeping and things begin to go well for him until one day he finds out that a woman is about to enter his life.

videos.title: A Woman Enters Into My Life
videos.overview: After discovering Chakrapani’s diary, a new chapter unfolds in Kumar’s life. He now plans every step on the way to make his life turn out the way he wants. But, will he be successful? Can he really cheat fate?

videos.title: An Introduction A New Friendship
videos.overview: Kumar meets Meera and instantly feels a connection with her. Even though he is attracted towards Meera, the words in Chakrapani’s diary haunt Kumar and refrain him from taking any action. Is this the mysterious woman Kumar needs to avoid? Will Kumar be able to keep destiny by the bay?

videos.title: Nima In Mind Meera In Dreams
videos.overview: Kumar makes a visit to Meera’s house. This visit leaves him in a big conflict in his mind. While contemplating the consequences his action will have on his marriage and on Nima, a gripping curiosity forces him to think otherwise. Meera now inhabits Kumar’s mind and thoughts. What will Kumar do now? Will he succumb to the force of destiny?

videos.title: Elusional
videos.overview: Kumar gets hold of the photos Meera sent him. These photos start a turmoil in Kumar’s head as he draws parallels from when Chakrapani met Sundara. Will Kumar go down the same road as Chakrapani or will he choose the tough path?

videos.title: A Balance Lost
videos.overview: Even after Chakrapani’s warning in the diary, Kumar starts to fall in love with Meera. This starts a new romantic chapter in his life similar to that of Chakrapani. There comes many similarities between Kumar and Chakrapani’s stories. How will Kumar’s life change as he has developed feelings for Meera? Will it be a terrible start to his story or a terrible ending?

videos.title: Work, Wife, Friendship Losing Everything
videos.overview: Kumar’s life takes a terrible turn when Meera’s husband is murdered. The police arrest Kumar and he loses his job, his wife, his friends, and all that he has now is Meera and the diary. What will Kumar do now? Is he destined to stay with Meera or the diary? How will all these sudden events impact Kumar’s life now?

videos.title: I Will Write My Own Destiny
videos.overview: After everything goes wrong in his life, Kumar decides to not make his life similar to that of Chakrapani. Therefore, he challenges Chakrapani that he will decide his future and write his own fate. Kumar decides to not refer to Chakrapani’s diary anymore. Before Kumar can leave, Chakrapani stops him and tears a page from his diary. He folds it and puts it in Kumar’s pocket saying that one day Kumar will need this page. What is written on that page? Will Kumar be able to rewrite his destiny?

videos.title: Nima Dream Or Reality
videos.overview: After the arrest in Meera’s husband’s murder case, Kumar lost everything; his job, his friends, and his wife. Now that Kumar has nothing to lose and the fact that Nima will never come back to him, Kumar decides to change his fate and win. What will Kumar do to change his future? Will Kumar be able to choose a different way or will Chakrapani will still be in his life?

videos.title: I Will Win The Battle
videos.overview: A lady hires Kumar’s cab and they start a conversation during their journey. The unknown lady talks to Kumar about her husband. While Kumar listens to her carefully, he can’t help but compare the incidents that the woman shared to the strangely similar incidents mentioned in the diary. Kumar wonders if this woman is Chakrapani’s wife. After the strange encounter with the woman, Kumar thinks that this could be his only chance to prove that his life is different than that of Chakrapani.

videos.title: The Last Parallel Journey
videos.overview: Despite all the efforts, nothing has changed. You can try hard to change your destiny but you always meet the same fate that is decided for you. Now that Kumar’s efforts have gone to waste and he is back to square one, Kumar decides to confront Chakrapani as he has no other option left. As the final face-off between Kumar and Chakrapani begins, who will be the winner? Will Kumar finally defeat Chakrapani in his game or will he lose again?
